note: sampled drawings for the two sandboxes; the imaginary cases also carry exact grid and inflections

adders.name: the operator's alternating odd
adders.note: signs alternate, powers odd, coefficients one

adders.name: the plain climb
adders.note: every power from 1 to 4, all adding the same way

adders.name: the folded leaf
adders.note: the cubic doubled and negative, so the middle folds back

adders.name: the parabola alone
adders.note: one even term: the simplest curve the adder can show

adders.name: high mixed
adders.note: mixed parity at degree 7: this is also the shape the imaginary variable needs

imaginary.name: odd only
imaginary.note: every odd power of i b is imaginary, so x is identically zero: a vertical line

imaginary.name: one even term added
imaginary.note: one even term is enough to open the curve; x is that term, sign-rotated

imaginary.name: even and odd balanced
imaginary.note: both parities at every power: the widest curve the substitution makes
